sn41.9:1.1: The phrase _purāṇagihisahāya_ (“old friend from the lay life”) appears only here and at [mn124:2.1](). There it is also said of a naked ascetic (_acela_) called Kassapa, which cannot be a coincidence. The events of that discourse happened many decades after the Buddha’s death.
sn41.9:2.4: Following BB’s reading kim hi no siya based on Se. See however my comment on kathanhi no siya at SN 22.1
sn41.9:2.6: punctuation in MS has been corrected, ellipsis is added.
